{
"id":"MOTIF-05",
"title":"Shared layer versus product overlay",
"section":"motion",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"web_public,app_interactive,document_flow,pdf_fixed,deck_presentation",
"requirement":"`landometer.motif.v3` is the product-neutral shared layer. Product animated identities are separately registered overlays with their own final fallback, duration, minimum size and host surface (`ijji.logo-sting.r3` exists: Hop → Bodies → Tagline → Hello → Hold, 9.0 s full / 6.4 s mark-only, ≥ 320 / 160 px). CityMETER, CityWiki and CityChat stings are produced in the Motif Studio under the same contract and enter the manifest with SHA-256 and owner approval before the DS references them. Families are never mixed in one lockup; navigation, favicon and OG images use official identity files, never motifs.\n\n\nทะเบียน product overlay ของ release นี้อยู่ใน `machine.contracts.motifRegister#/productOverlays` ตามคำตัดสินของเจ้าของ 15 กันยายน 2569: `ijji.logo-sting.r3` (runtime `1a1d1bc2…`, stills `bb1bc80e…` / `acac2c65…`) และ `ijji.four-beat.selected-3.r3` (state-bound: graph-b, rings-c, rotate-b; ใช้เฉพาะขณะมี pending operation จริง มี status text และปุ่ม cancel) อนุมัติแล้วใน manifest 1.2.1 · CityChat conversation set (SVG 7 ไฟล์ + `citychat-motif-motion.js/.css`) อนุมัติโดยเจ้าของตาม bytes ปัจจุบันของ repo (commit a99f3c1e) โดยป้าย candidate ของทะเบียนต้นทางเป็นบันทึกประวัติ ณ วันที่รับ bytes ไม่ใช่ข้อสรุปสถานะเว็บปัจจุบัน; ใช้ approval/hash record ที่ส่งพร้อม Add-on แยกของผลิตภัณฑ์ · CityMETER และ CityWiki stings มี historical pre-approval; ใช้ได้ต่อเมื่อ current product registry มี approved bytes และ exact hash จริง overlay ทุกตัวใช้ได้เฉพาะงานของผลิตภัณฑ์นั้น ไม่ผสมกับ shared motif ใน lockup เดียว และไม่สร้าง product fact ใด ๆ (สี ความหมาย ความสามารถของผลิตภัณฑ์อยู่ใน Product Brief/Add-on ของผลิตภัณฑ์นั้น)\n\nCandidate briefs สำหรับ Studio 1.4 (ยังไม่ได้วาด ไม่ใช่ asset): `receipt` — closure เมื่อออกใบรับตัวเลข/decision log (job: handoff) · `compare` — transition ของสองพื้นที่เคียงกัน (job: spatial_transition) · `citymeter.pending` — ตระกูล state-bound (ต้องมี status text และ cancel ที่ทำงานจริง) · product stings ของ CityMETER / CityWiki / CityChat",
"acceptance":[{"checkId":"MOTIF-05-A","method":"automated","criterion":"overlay ที่ deliver อยู่ใน `machine.contracts.motifRegister#/productOverlays` ด้วย hash ตรงและ `approval.status: owner_approved`; productScope ของ overlay ตรงกับ product layer ของ Build Card; ไม่มี overlay กับ shared motif ใน lockup เดียว"},{"checkId":"MOTIF-05-B","method":"manual","criterion":"overlay ไม่ถูกใช้แทน official identity ใน navigation, favicon หรือ OG image และไม่สื่อความหมายเชิงหลักฐาน"}],
"sourceTextSha256":"ff2be4f2b65b3bd51de3cd9c2bc1618308273af08fdc9a3a371bd79854fb13db",
"sourceRuleId":"MOTIF-05"
},
{
"id":"MOTIF-06",
"title":"Every motif sits on a measured carrier",
"section":"motion",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"web_public,app_interactive,document_flow,pdf_fixed,deck_presentation,social_static",
"requirement":"A motif's colours are fixed by its governed file, so its legibility is decided by the ground it sits on. Every placement — a MotifFrame or a static final-state image — declares that ground, and a placement is allowed only when `machine.contracts.motifRegister#/carrierPolicy` lists its kind × variant × carrier for every theme the output renders: every visible authored paint composites at 1.30:1 or more on the carrier (a gradient at its worst stop). `full` variants (Brand Blue ink) sit only on plain light carriers; `quiet` variants (one sky ink) sit only on deep carriers, Brand Blue included. A `full` variant never sits on Brand Blue, on a dark surface or on any atmosphere gradient. Runtime renditions keep the governed inks (`ink=\"blue\"` for full, the default sky for quiet). A failing pair is fixed by changing the carrier, then the variant, then the size or spacing, then by removing the motif — never on the asset: no recolour, plate, scrim, new tint, or opacity carrying meaning.\n\n\nที่มา: `motif-quiet-fallback.json` (landometer-quiet-fallback/1.0) ที่เจ้าของอนุมัติ 11 กันยายน 2569 เป็น normative ของงานที่ใช้ Motif Library 1.2.1 และคำตัดสินของเจ้าของ 16 กันยายน 2569 ให้นำเข้า DS ในรอบนี้แทนประโยคพื้นของแพตช์ r2 ใน MOTIF-04 ซึ่งวัดแล้วขัดกับ bytes: SVG แบบ full ทั้งหกมี Brand Blue `#1D4497` อยู่ในตัว จึงเหลือ 1.00:1 บน Brand Blue (หมุดโลโก้ เส้นฐาน วงใน แผ่นฐาน ตัวพาย และต้นกล้าหายไป) และบน atmosphere ทั้งสี่ชุดมีบางส่วนต่ำกว่า 1.30:1 ส่วน quiet ใช้หมึก energy.sky `#59D2FE` สีเดียว บนพื้นสว่างทุกแบบส่วนที่เข้มที่สุดได้เพียง 1.23–1.74:1 แต่บนพื้นทึบธีมมืดได้ 3.37–10.23:1 และบน Brand Blue 2.74–5.19:1 ครบรูป ตัวเลขทุกค่าวัดใหม่จาก bytes ที่ hash ตรงด้วย `measure-motif-carriers-0.9.4.mjs` (composite 8-bit เหมือนที่จอแสดง) และตรงกับตารางของ ladder ทุกค่า\n\n| variant | วางได้ (ทุก kind เว้นที่ระบุ) | ห้าม |\n|---|---|---|\n| `full` | `surface.canvas`, `surface.card`, `surface.raised`, `surface.alt`, `surface.soft`, `surface.blueTint`, `surface.beigeTint` ของธีมสว่าง และ `brand.beige` — `layers` ได้เฉพาะ canvas, card และ raised (แถวจางของมันได้ 1.21–1.26:1 บนพื้นสว่างอื่น และ 1.30:1 พอดีเกณฑ์บน canvas) | Brand Blue · พื้นธีมมืดทุกแบบ · atmosphere ทุกชุด · ภาพถ่าย · พื้นของ semantic state |\n| `quiet` | `surface.*` ทุกตัวของธีมมืด, `brand.blue`, `atmosphere.ground.current`, `atmosphere.measure.deep` — `layers` ได้เฉพาะพื้นทึบ (บน atmosphere เข้มวงจางที่สุดได้ 1.27–1.28:1) | พื้นสว่างทุกแบบ · `atmosphere.ground.mist`, `atmosphere.measure.luminous` · gradient ของ cultivate, diversity และ product · ภาพถ่าย |\n\nการประกาศ: ทุก MotifFrame และทุกภาพ motif แบบนิ่งบนเว็บ (`data-motif-static=\"<kind>-<variant>\"`) มี `data-host-surface` เป็น carrier id จาก `carrierPolicy.carriers` — id ที่เปลี่ยนตามธีม (เช่น `surface.card`) ถูกตรวจแยกทุกธีมที่งานรองรับ (`<meta name=\"color-scheme\">`; ไม่ประกาศ = ทั้งสองธีม), รูป `<id>@light` หรือ `<id>@dark` หมายถึงพื้นที่ทาค่าธีมนั้นคงที่ทั้งสองธีม และ id ที่ไม่เปลี่ยนตามธีม (`brand.beige`, `brand.blue`, `atmosphere.*`) ใช้ค่าเดียว · `data-variant` คือ variant ของธีมสว่าง และ `data-variant-dark=\"quiet\"` สลับ frame แบบ full บนพื้นที่เปลี่ยนตามธีมให้เป็น quiet ในธีมมืด (MotifFrame สลับ attribute `quiet` ของ runtime และ `<noscript>` มี SVG ทั้งสองแบบใน wrapper `.lds-motif-noscript` ที่ติด `data-theme-variant=\"light|dark\"` ซึ่งเลือกธีมแบบเดียวกับหน้า — `data-theme` ก่อน แล้วจึงค่าของระบบ; `<picture>` ที่ตามเฉพาะค่าของระบบใช้แทนไม่ได้) ซึ่งเป็นการสลับแบบเดียวที่ตารางวัดยอมรับ · MotifFrame ปฏิเสธคู่ที่ไม่อยู่ในทะเบียน พื้นที่ทาจริงที่ไม่ตรงกับที่ประกาศ และค่า `ink` ที่ไม่มีไฟล์รองรับ แล้วถอด frame ออกจากการแสดงผล (ขั้น L5) · งาน export แบบนิ่ง (PDF, deck, social, email) ใช้ตารางเดียวกันกับพื้นของหน้านั้น · Build Card `motionMoments[]` และ `staticMotifPlacements[]` บันทึก `hostSurface`, ค่าพื้นต่อธีม, คอนทราสต์ที่วัด, verdict และขั้นของ ladder ที่ใช้\n\nลำดับการแก้เมื่อคู่ไม่ผ่าน (ladder L1–L5 ของไฟล์ที่อนุมัติ): L1 วัดกับพื้นจริงที่ขนาดจริง · L2 ย้ายไปพื้นอื่นในตาราง · L3 เปลี่ยน variant (เป็นการเลือก record ไม่ใช่การเปลี่ยนสี) · L4 เพิ่มขนาดหรือระยะว่าง · L5 ถอดลายออก — ถ้าความจริงบนหน้าเปลี่ยนเมื่อถอดลาย แปลว่าลายกำลังทำงานที่ไม่ได้รับอนุญาต ถ้าต้องการ `full` บนพื้นเข้มหรือ Brand Blue ในอนาคต Motif Studio ต้องผลิต final-state record เฉพาะพื้นเข้มแล้วลงทะเบียนพร้อม hash ก่อน (แบบที่ `ijji.four-beat.selected-3.r3` มี record หกพื้น) โลโก้ทำแบบนี้ไม่ได้เพราะหมุดต้องเป็น `#1D4497`",
"acceptance":[
{"checkId":"MOTIF-06-A","method":"automated","criterion":"ทุก `.lds-motif-frame` และ `[data-motif-static]` มี `data-host-surface` ที่ resolve ได้ใน `machine.contracts.motifRegister#/carrierPolicy/carriers`; คู่ kind × variant × carrier ของทุกธีมที่งาน render อยู่ใน `carrierPolicy.allowed`; frame แบบ full มี `ink=\"blue\"` และ frame แบบ quiet ไม่มี ink อื่นนอกจาก sky; frame ที่สลับธีมมี SVG ทั้งสองแบบใน `<noscript>` แยก wrapper ตามธีม; `measure-motif-carriers-0.9.4.mjs --register` วัด 12 ไฟล์ × 20 carrier ใหม่แล้วตรงกับทะเบียน; preflight PF-MOTIF-06-CARRIER ผ่าน"},
{"checkId":"MOTIF-06-B","method":"interaction","methodDetail":"interaction/visual","criterion":"ในเบราว์เซอร์ทั้งธีมสว่างและธีมมืด สีพื้นที่ render จริงหลังทุก frame และทุกภาพนิ่งเท่ากับ carrier ที่ประกาศ และทุก paint ของ final-state SVG ได้ 1.30:1 ขึ้นไปบนพื้นนั้น; สลับธีมแล้ว variant เปลี่ยนตาม `data-variant-dark`; frame ที่ถูกปฏิเสธไม่แสดงผล"},
{"checkId":"MOTIF-06-C","method":"manual","criterion":"เมื่อคู่ไม่ผ่าน การแก้เดินตาม L1–L5 และบันทึก `quietFallbackRung` ใน Build Card; ไม่มีการ recolor, แผ่นรอง, scrim, สีใหม่ หรือ opacity ที่ถือความหมาย"}
],
"sourceTextSha256":"9d8511234895472dac10052112be19fd9e298aa575b44b4ef5cc59d837d44c11",
"sourceRuleId":"MOTIF-06"
},
{
"id":"A11Y-01",
"title":"Semantics and direct operation survive every state",
"section":"accessibility",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"all",
"requirement":"ทุก applicable artifact MUST meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA เป็น floor Information structure, names, roles, values, focus order, alternatives, status announcements และ direct operation MUST equivalent ใน initial, hydrated, loading, success, empty, error, reduced-motion, high-zoom, keyboard, touch, print และ export states ที่ applicable Native HTML/format-native structure comes first; ARIA supplements rather than repairs wrong semantics",
"acceptance":[{"checkId":"A11Y-01-A","method":"automated","criterion":"zero critical/serious release-blocking errors; normal text ≥4.5:1, large text ≥3:1 และ required non-text/focus ≥3:1 ในทุก applicable state"},{"checkId":"A11Y-01-B","method":"manual","criterion":"keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, reflow, reduced-motion และ touch checks มี receipts"}],
"sourceTextSha256":"9f3b853fdad7a1f66dcc5b10cc137cf9535eb00dff4f9a769bc7c6aabb71b142",
"sourceRuleId":"A11Y-01"
},
{"id":"CLAIM-MACHINE-01","title":"Claims have stable machine-readable records","section":"discovery","normativeLevel":"MUST","scope":"public,agent_readable","requirement":"Material public claim ทุกอัน MUST มี stable claimId และ machine-readable record ซึ่ง wording, entity, locale, scope, explicit authority class/boundary, value/assertion, unit, geography, time basis, source, method, status, confidence/limitation, owner และ last-reviewed date ตรง visible claim","acceptance":[{"checkId":"CLAIM-MACHINE-01-A","method":"automated","criterion":"claim IDs unique และ required field มีค่าหรือ explicit not_applicable; public-eligible evidence/provenance refs เป็น stable public HTTPS URL หรือ URN ไม่ใช่ local path"},{"checkId":"CLAIM-MACHINE-01-B","method":"manual","criterion":"sample visible-to-machine comparison ไม่มี scope, value, date, status หรือ evidence drift"}],"sourceTextSha256":"d6335f128667b691fc9cb3840a3856ebf98ab1c1e2b39afd10d30108ae3eed34","sourceRuleId":"CLAIM-MACHINE-01"},
{
"id":"DISCOVERY-01",
"title":"Initial and hydrated meaning are equivalent",
"section":"discovery",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"web_public,app_interactive",
"requirement":"Public page MUST expose title, primary answer, headings, material claims, evidence links, destinations และ language relationship ใน initial semantic HTML; hydration MUST NOT replace, contradict หรือ hide meaning นั้น\n\n\nArtifact ที่ claim `artifact_qa_passed` หรือสูงกว่าสำหรับ `web_public` MUST มี `delivery.primaryHtmlBinding` ซึ่งตรงกับ entry `text/html` หนึ่งไฟล์ใน `delivery.files` ทั้ง path, media type และ SHA-256 Validator MUST parse bytes ของไฟล์นั้นจริงและเทียบ `html lang`, unique title/description/robots, canonical, hreflang, Open Graph, strict JSON-LD, visible H1, marked primary answer, exact claim + limitation text, evidence destination, navigation/action label + destination และ visible locale links กับ discovery/structured-data/claim/action contracts Content ที่ hidden, inert, `aria-hidden`, non-rendered, transparent, clipped หรือ visually hidden MUST NOT satisfy visible truth การมี declaration ที่ถูกต้องแต่ final initial HTML ไม่ตรงยังเป็น failure `delivery.webDiscoveryEvidence` MUST bind artifact/build/primary HTML identity และ exact no-script, hydrated-DOM, accessibility-tree, internal-locale-link กับ sitemap evidence; Production probe และ resolved production evidence MUST bind hash ของ primary HTML นี้โดยตรง",
"acceptance":[{"checkId":"DISCOVERY-01-A","method":"automated","criterion":"exact hash-bound delivered primary initial HTML parse แล้วตรง governed lang, unique metadata, canonical/hreflang/social, strict JSON-LD, visible H1, exact marked primary answer, claim/limitation, evidence และ action/navigation destinations; hidden/non-rendered truth ใช้ผ่านไม่ได้; hash-bound no-script, hydrated DOM และ accessibility-tree snapshots ยังรักษา exact primary meaning/destinations และ receipt cite evidence ทั้งสาม"},{"checkId":"DISCOVERY-01-B","method":"production","criterion":"deployed canonical URL ตอบ crawlable success, observed content hash เท่า bound primary initial HTML และมี primary content เดียวกัน"}],
"sourceTextSha256":"6643e251bbc0ba428e97bc07d8252507e9725b80d534f3e131ab5e0d285c394d",
"sourceRuleId":"DISCOVERY-01"
},
{
"id":"DISCOVERY-02",
"title":"Canonical, locale, index, and sitemap signals agree",
"section":"discovery",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"web_public,app_interactive",
"requirement":"Indexable page ทุกหน้า MUST มี stable self-canonical URL หนึ่งอัน, explicit language alternates เมื่อมี equivalent, consistent robots/sitemap treatment, working language links และไม่มี automatic language redirect ที่ขัด discovery/user choice",
"acceptance":[{"checkId":"DISCOVERY-02-A","method":"automated","criterion":"canonical, hreflang, HTML lang, robots, social metadata, JSON-LD identity, hash-bound delivered sitemap, visible internal locale links และ hash-bound internal-locale-link snapshot เป็น exact governed graph; sitemap loc set เท่ากับ governed locale route URLs และ receipt cite no-script/hydrated/accessibility/sitemap/internal-locale evidence ครบ"},{"checkId":"DISCOVERY-02-B","method":"production","criterion":"canonical/alternate URLs resolve โดยไม่มี loop, soft error หรือ locale-forcing redirect"}],
"sourceTextSha256":"acfa18386a55a990d323cc0d26c08cf7e536a5ed01f4cb4f1e86a5009ccf5df7",
"sourceRuleId":"DISCOVERY-02"
},
{
"id":"DISCOVERY-03",
"title":"Machine discovery never overstates permission or quality",
"section":"discovery",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"web_public,agent_readable",
"requirement":"Structured data MUST describe visible approved truth และ match page kind Sitemap, robots, crawler access และ optional llms navigation เป็น discovery controls เท่านั้น ไม่ใช่ evidence, permission, licensing, readiness, ranking หรือ quality guarantee",
"acceptance":[{"checkId":"DISCOVERY-03-A","method":"automated","criterion":"initial HTML มี JSON-LD document เดียวที่ root มีเฉพาะ `@context` + `@graph`, context เป็น `https://schema.org`, graph entity set ตรง governed projection และแต่ละ entity มีเฉพาะ exact `@id`, `@type`, `name`, `url`; property/entity/type/claim/permission/readiness/ranking/quality ที่เพิ่มเองเป็น blocking overclaim"},{"checkId":"DISCOVERY-03-B","method":"manual","criterion":"ไม่มี discovery file/crawler directive ถูกอ้างเป็น authorization, evidence หรือ ranking promise"},{"checkId":"DISCOVERY-03-C","method":"manual","criterion":"indexable route passes distinct question, answer/task, material content, evidence and maintained-owner useful-page test"},{"checkId":"DISCOVERY-03-D","method":"automated","criterion":"crawler decisions purpose-separated; optional AI navigation derives canonical public routes only and carries no permission/readiness meaning"}],
"sourceTextSha256":"bc046b7a1e798f203b390530b81e30f726f1eb582de8f8f1598a9194410f150a",
"sourceRuleId":"DISCOVERY-03"
},
{
"id":"AGENT-01",
"title":"Agent-readable does not mean agent-authorized",
"section":"agents",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"agent_readable,agent_action",
"requirement":"Agent interface MUST แยก readable information, available capability, required permission, confirmation, execution และ receipt Agent MUST NOT infer authorization จาก discoverability, UI affordance, credential หรือ absence of denial",
"acceptance":[
{"checkId":"AGENT-01-A","method":"automated","criterion":"machine action ทุกอัน hash-bind immutable definition, typed input schema/value, actor-scoped authority, side-effect/confirmation policy และ exact bytes ของ result/receipt schemas; definition, runtime และ Build Card ต้องตรงกันทั้ง `productScope` และ conditional `namedProduct`; runtime state ห้าม redefine authority"},
{"checkId":"AGENT-01-B","method":"interaction","criterion":"mutation fixtures block execution เมื่อ actor scope, unexpired authority, input classification, operation, permission, confirmation หรือ external/costly authority class ไม่ตรง; ทุก execution ที่เริ่มแล้วต้องมี signed `pre_start` revocation decision ซึ่ง bind nonce/build/artifact/action/actor สดภายในห้านาทีก่อนเริ่ม และออก attestation ไม่ช้ากว่า `startedAt` ส่วน `succeeded | failed | cancelled` MUST เพิ่ม signed `terminal_boundary` decision ที่มีคนละ `revocationId`, record และ attestation ซึ่งตรวจตั้งแต่ applicable effect-or-terminal boundary จนไม่เกินห้านาทีหลัง boundary; terminal receipt MUST bind decision หลังนี้ ตรง runtime ทั้ง operation/status/timestamps/side effect/result/recovery และมี externally pinned `agent_execution` attestation"}
],
"sourceTextSha256":"14121a98c34dc9dc3152f53fa053a35708f3c809ebcb328c9c49a4f9c684e054",
"sourceRuleId":"AGENT-01"
},
{"id":"SECURITY-01","title":"Public presentation cannot reveal restricted evidence","section":"privacy-security","normativeLevel":"MUST","scope":"all","requirement":"Output, metadata, preview, source map, machine projection, log และ agent receipt MUST เคารพ data classification และ MUST NOT เปิดเผย restricted evidence, personal data, credential หรือ internal-only source detail","acceptance":[{"checkId":"SECURITY-01-A","method":"automated","criterion":"secret, personal-data, private-URL และ restricted-field scans ผ่าน"},{"checkId":"SECURITY-01-B","method":"manual","criterion":"disclosure ยังมีประโยชน์โดยไม่ข้าม evidence boundary"}],"sourceTextSha256":"f43247a3b4dbb4fc9301465be72c58955e448612434b4bdf2e433ee6b52adfb0","sourceRuleId":"SECURITY-01"},
{
"id":"DATAVIZ-01",
"title":"Data visualization preserves analytical meaning",
"section":"capability-packs",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"data_visualization",
"requirement":"Chart, score, comparison หรือ quantitative diagram MUST declare question, measure, unit, denominator, time, geography, grain, transform, uncertainty, schema release, claim/evidence IDs, scale และ accessible alternative Color ไม่เป็น carrier เดียว Truncated axis ต้องมีเหตุผล Observation แยก interpretation และ incompatible series ห้าม normalize เพื่อความสวย",
"acceptance":[{"checkId":"DATAVIZ-01-A","method":"automated","criterion":"required overlay fields, scale (family จาก `machine.tokens#/analyticalScales` หรือ series จาก `machine.tokens#/categoricalSeries`), Build Card `scaleFamilies[]` และ `seriesVariant`, non-color cues, value states ของ EVID-05, claim/evidence IDs and accessible data alternative resolve"},{"checkId":"DATAVIZ-01-B","method":"manual","criterion":"form, scale, baseline, ordering, annotation, uncertainty and conclusion preserve meaning in format"}],
"sourceTextSha256":"7260458ff77f38e5a07e202e2067f9c8d07b0fda9b73527ef0a44f78a91d1524",
"sourceRuleId":"DATAVIZ-01"
},
{
"id":"DATAVIZ-02",
"title":"Sequential scales use three distinct-hue anchors and exact approved samples",
"section":"capability-packs",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"data_visualization,map",
"requirement":"Select the family from the metric and denominator. Each of the 20 analytical families has three explicit approved anchors at 0%, 50%, 100% (LUT indices 0, 20, 40), summarized below and fully specified in machine.analyticalScales. Consume the exact 41-sample sRGB table and its class projections. Do not interpolate a new palette from endpoints or three anchors at consumption.\n\n\nEvery sequential midpoint MUST turn toward a visibly different hue from the end, not merely a lighter end tint. Starts are the approved family-specific semantic near-whites; universal cream is not required. The midpoint is a perceptual turn within a single numerical direction, not zero, balance or a threshold. OKLab lightness and relative luminance strictly decrease from low to high on BOTH themes. The exact approved LIGHT anchors, LUT and class colors are used unchanged on a dark surface with the same direction. Activity uses cool mint/blue; water remains aquatic rather than lime-dominant; density families stay warm.\n\n| Family | Kind | Same anchors on light and dark |\n|---|---|---|\n| `activity` | sequential | `#F1F5E5` → `#60C9AD` → `#25659A` |\n| `density.area` | sequential | `#FFF1D9` → `#E6AB30` → `#D6600C` |\n| `heat` | sequential | `#FFF6CF` → `#F5B323` → `#C72D10` |\n| `risk` | sequential | `#FFF0E5` → `#F27642` → `#A40822` |\n| `price` | sequential | `#F4F4DD` → `#74C4C2` → `#216D58` |\n| `age` | sequential | `#F5F0DF` → `#9DBACB` → `#526832` |\n| `density.household` | sequential | `#FFF2E4` → `#EF84A3` → `#DF491F` |\n| `growth` | sequential | `#EEF5E5` → `#B2C75B` → `#2B702F` |\n| `confidence` | sequential | `#EEF4EB` → `#66AEDF` → `#236A5E` |\n| `count` | sequential | `#F4F0E7` → `#7DBAC0` → `#213E70` |\n| `water` | sequential | `#EEF7FC` → `#3DBBCD` → `#073E78` |\n| `density.capita` | sequential | `#FFF0ED` → `#F3A076` → `#B72B63` |\n| `built` | sequential | `#FFF5D8` → `#F3BC93` → `#BFA000` |\n| `duration` | sequential | `#EEF2F5` → `#98B1A4` → `#33433E` |\n| `balance` | diverging | `#CF5148` → `#F1F3EC` → `#3B87BF` |\n| `delta` | diverging | `#CF5420` → `#F1F3EC` → `#3C9278` |\n| `tradeoff` | diverging | `#B79900` → `#F1F3EC` → `#739CDE` |\n| `flow` | diverging | `#C95368` → `#F1F3EC` → `#2E9095` |\n| `sentiment` | diverging | `#C95170` → `#F1F3EC` → `#49944D` |\n| `anomaly` | diverging | `#4084C7` → `#F1F3EC` → `#D44C3A` |\n\nFourteen sequential families retain explicit metric meaning: activity for activity/usage; density.area for a declared area denominator; heat for measured heat; risk for source-supported risk; price for monetary quantities; age for elapsed age; density.household for a household denominator; growth for a nonnegative cumulative magnitude (signed change uses delta); confidence for stated uncertainty/quality; count for totals, not density; water for water measurements; density.capita for a population/person denominator; built for governed footprint, height or coverage including explicitly defined built-density; duration for travel, waiting or inundation time.\n\nDensity areas remain orange, per-capita rose, household scarlet and built-form gold. Legends MUST show the actual unit and denominator; a color never establishes official population, eligibility, risk or behavior. A topic alone does not choose a denominator.\n\nOne analytical surface uses at most one family per hue zone. Independently labelled panels with their own metric, legend and reading path are separate surfaces. A reference atlas compares families rather than overlaying unrelated measurements. Names, units, thresholds and non-color cues remain necessary: neither the 20 families nor the 17 supporting colors are guaranteed to be universally distinguishable by color alone.\n\nThe six diverging families are balance, delta, tradeoff, flow, sentiment and anomaly. Their midpoint MUST be meaningful and named; both themes use the same approved light table and signed direction. The neutral class spans a declared interval, not automatically only exact zero. Do not infer equal perceptual weight, goodness or danger from either arm.\n\nDiscrete classes use n ∈ {3,5,7,9} and exact indices round(i × 40 / (n − 1)), i = 0…n−1. Prefer 5–7 for compact marks. Adjacent class ΔE OKLab is a diagnostic, not an accessibility certificate; the supplied sets meet the retained 2.2 threshold.\n\nThe consumer supplies domain, classification method, exact thresholds, unit, direction and outlier policy. No-domain selection MUST NOT invent thresholds. Continuous intervals are [lower, upper) except the closed last interval; a displayed integer and its class must agree. Outliers need explicit rejection, approved extension or a declared end-bin, never silent clamping. Renderer, legend, table and export MUST use identical values, thresholds and colors.",
"acceptance":[{"checkId":"DATAVIZ-02-A","method":"automated","criterion":"selected family resolves its exact approved light-source LUT with 41 samples and three anchors at 0/20/40; light and dark anchors/LUT/classes are equal; sequential lightness and relative luminance decrease on both themes; class indices and renderer/legend/table values agree; no endpoint interpolation or silent normalization"},{"checkId":"DATAVIZ-02-B","method":"visual","criterion":"the actual continuous ramp and selected classes are readable without band/hue reversal at their delivered sizes in each offered theme/print context; independent analytical panels preserve clear family/denominator labels and accessible non-color alternatives"}],
"sourceTextSha256":"41b94e249f69785a091653ba32b34184fbb55525baf676a19612823db9073d9c",
"sourceRuleId":"DATAVIZ-02"
},
{
"id":"DATAVIZ-03",
"title":"Analytical values and their direction are invariant across themes",
"section":"capability-packs",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"data_visualization,map",
"requirement":"The owner explicitly adopts the original LIGHT HEX values on dark backgrounds unchanged. Every dark analytical anchor, LUT sample and class MUST equal the corresponding light value and index. Story supporting colors and Location role accents also retain their original light HEX on both themes. No derived dark formula, HEX inversion, per-theme recoloring, opacity adjustment that changes encoded color, direction reversal or alternate normalization is allowed.\n\n\nKeep the data colors when improving contrast: use readable numerical/text labels, meaningful boundaries or a neutral backplate/plot surface. Check the actual displayed size and surface. Known examples on dark.canvas #11191D are water high #073E78 (about 1.67:1), count high #213E70 (about 1.68:1) and duration high #33433E (about 1.71:1); these fills need visible boundaries, labels or a suitable neutral plot backplate in the artifact. This rule is not a claim that all fills attain 3:1 on dark, that 16 roles are color-only distinguishable, or that package checks establish accessibility. The original categorical soft/vivid/ink palettes, foundation pairs, seven decorative gradients and product identity/motif contracts retain their separate existing theme behavior; they are outside this analytical same-HEX decision.",
"acceptance":[{"checkId":"DATAVIZ-03-A","method":"automated","criterion":"light and dark anchors, LUTs, classes, indices and value direction match exactly; supporting and Location role HEX are unchanged across themes; no derived dark formula or custom interpolation is used"},{"checkId":"DATAVIZ-03-B","method":"automated","criterion":"sequential lightness decreases in both themes, diverging arms preserve the approved light-source directions, applicable hue gates pass for every sample, and CSS/token/profile projections bind exact delivered bytes"},{"checkId":"DATAVIZ-03-C","method":"visual","criterion":"text, values, sign, zero, missing states and boundaries remain readable on actual light/dark surfaces; labels or neutral backplates solve insufficient contrast without recoloring encoded values; report CVD/grayscale and actual-size review separately"}],
"sourceTextSha256":"83a3c0d334dc2890a7cdebde27edd63cce5e99ef885f8fd2fe4323f00b6df6ad",
"sourceRuleId":"DATAVIZ-03"
},
{
"id":"GATE-01",
"title":"Data-colour gates run for both themes on every release",
"section":"quality",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"release",
"requirement":"Validate the current approved snapshot, exact token/LUT/production-CSS projections, all 20 families × 2 themes × 41 samples, categorical fill/ink and declared step/hue diagnostics. A mismatch or undeclared failure blocks package use. Save scoped, dated evidence bound to the exact files/hashes; historical gate reports do not certify new bytes. Package checks MUST NOT be described as complete artifact, native-language, CVD or account-installation validation.\n\n\nThe current package verifier checks immutable-source integrity, approved color snapshot parity, typed policy, complete assets and analytical mathematics. The artifact checker separately inspects supported delivered formats and reports its limits. Actual foreground/background contrast, gray/CVD usability, thresholds, native Thai/English composition, keyboard/zoom and export review remain artifact-specific. No new exception may be invented to bypass a failed MUST; any proposed normative change requires owner decision and the version policy in §0.2.",
"acceptance":[{"checkId":"GATE-01-A","method":"automated","criterion":"current exact snapshot, token/LUT/CSS parity, 40 records/1,640 samples, approved class indices/steps and applicable hue checks pass with hash-bound evidence; failed or untested checks are not reported as pass"},{"checkId":"GATE-01-B","method":"manual","criterion":"the release record accurately distinguishes owner approval, package diagnostics and artifact review; no new exception, signature, conformance level or platform activation is claimed without its actual authority/evidence"}],
"sourceTextSha256":"af8afb668c5a371cd6f5552c564f2f32cbcdcf8b54464835d7933b1605ff2ec3",
"sourceRuleId":"GATE-01"
},
{
"id":"DATAVIZ-04",
"title":"Analytical values stay out of the retired hue windows",
"section":"capability-packs",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"data_visualization,map,release",
"requirement":"Every delivered analytical LUT sample, class, anchor and categorical fill/ink in both themes must satisfy the applicable retired-color gates. Earth: OKLCh H 30–100°, C .035–.145, L ≤ .62. Violet: H 285–345°, C ≥ .04. Light clay band H 22–100°, C .09–.145, L .62–.74 is a warning. Proximity to the eight retired earth/taupe values within a 20° hue lane must not be below ΔE 6. The ten exact retired values remain prohibited. Warm pink H 350–20° is allowed; no new token may be minted to escape a gate. The exact retired-value list and gate parameters are in the embedded machine contract.\n\n\nThe scope includes all 41 samples, not only three displayed anchors. Governed semantic states and approved image pixels keep their own role-specific contracts; the analytical ban does not authorize recoloring identity artwork or evidence media.",
"acceptance":[{"checkId":"DATAVIZ-04-A","method":"automated","criterion":"all current analytical samples/classes and categorical values satisfy the applicable earth/violet/proximity/exact-retired-value gates; light clay warnings are recorded; overrides pass the same checks and do not invent escape tokens"},{"checkId":"DATAVIZ-04-B","method":"visual","criterion":"delivered ramps/categories do not read as rejected brown, terracotta or violet; legal warm pink reads as intended in both offered themes on the actual screen/export"}],
"sourceTextSha256":"dc55ceee9a8a8c6cc3d4073ffd61357250ae6329e25fa5f9fbaa769e07141171",
"sourceRuleId":"DATAVIZ-04"
},
{
"id":"DATAVIZ-05",
"title":"Categorical series are luminous and edge-separated",
"section":"capability-packs",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"data_visualization,map",
"requirement":"Use `landometer-series-10-v8`, ten stable category IDs with exact theme-specific soft/vivid fill and ink roles. Current light values are retained; current dark soft/vivid/ink values are the approved redesigned set. Assignments persist by category ID through filtering and sorting. Default is soft; vivid is an explicit surface choice. Vivid charts and energy accents MUST NOT compete on the same surface. The governed sky energy-accent cue retains its surface constraints even in soft.\n\n\nFills need not reach 3:1 against canvas: adjacent areas require a ≥1px `border.default` edge or an ink outline; legend swatches require a hairline border. Text, lines and marks thinner than 3px use the ink tier, with ≥4.5:1 for normal text on its actual canvas/card. Where ink falls back to `text.primary`, category identity remains in fill plus cue. Preserve the ten cue assignments: circle, square, triangle, diamond, cross, star, hexagon, ring, dash, plus. Every use needs a non-color cue; slots 7–10 require their shape cue. Do not restore old v5 aliases or substitute old dark values.",
"acceptance":[{"checkId":"DATAVIZ-05-A","method":"automated","criterion":"colors resolve the exact v8 category/theme/variant/ink records by stable category ID; normal ink reaches 4.5:1 on its actual surface; required edges/legend borders and shape cues are present; thin marks use ink; delivered variant agrees with the Build Card and does not share a surface with a forbidden energy accent"},{"checkId":"DATAVIZ-05-B","method":"visual","criterion":"categories remain distinguishable at actual feed/print/dark sizes through labels/shapes/position as well as color; category-ID assignments do not change when filtered or sorted; no universal color-vision-accessibility claim is inferred from hue differences"}],
"sourceTextSha256":"7971a878627962235a61c3c9ffb61abbe8a52d3cab8efc78483d478f25b368fb",
"sourceRuleId":"DATAVIZ-05"
},
{
"id":"MAP-01",
"title":"Maps preserve geography and coverage truth",
"section":"capability-packs",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"map",
"requirement":"Map overlay MUST declare geography ID, boundary source, purpose, covered area, grain, time, unit, schema release, attribution/rights, projection เมื่อมีผล, หกสถานะของค่าตาม EVID-05 (`measured`, `measured_zero`, `no_data`, `out_of_scope`, `suppressed`, `not_yet`) รวมทั้ง low-confidence/selected/focus states และ nonspatial alternative Export records viewport/zoom/filters/data receipt It MUST NOT imply unsupported coverage, treat missing as zero or generalize product classification",
"acceptance":[{"checkId":"MAP-01-A","method":"automated","criterion":"fields/states/attribution/alternative/export receipt resolve; `dataStates` ครอบคลุม enum หกค่าของ EVID-05 ที่เกิดจริงในข้อมูล และ MapLegend แสดง state rows ที่มี"},{"checkId":"MAP-01-B","method":"manual","criterion":"boundary, context, legend, orientation, uncertainty and coverage remain truthful/readable"}],
"sourceTextSha256":"73d5301cd85d5bcd13e1376ad0a11eeb35186abe79a0cda76a1318a690dd6a88",
"sourceRuleId":"MAP-01"
},
{
"id":"WEBFMT-01",
"title":"Public web output remains semantic and resilient",
"section":"format-packs",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"web_public",
"requirement":"Public web MUST provide semantic initial HTML, responsive layout, keyboard/touch operation, no-script primary meaning, stable URLs, discoverability signals, share preview (square feed creative และ OG link preview 1200 × 630 ตาม SOCIALFMT-01), one approved icon set ตาม FAVICON-01, `<title>` ตาม pattern `[page] · [product]` และ production verification",
"acceptance":[{"checkId":"WEBFMT-01-A","method":"automated","criterion":"required rules pass supported viewport, locale, theme, no-script และ reduced-motion fixtures; icon set หกขนาด, web manifest, theme-color และ title pattern resolve (FAVICON-01-A); OG image resolve `target.social.og.1200x630.01` และ og:title/og:description ตรง template ของ SOCIALFMT-01"},{"checkId":"WEBFMT-01-B","method":"production","criterion":"deployed routes, assets, metadata, forms/actions และ monitoring receipts pass"}],
"sourceTextSha256":"36d1ae8713b4a9381a2262593272cb26fb3822204de418951667e09880ef939c",
"sourceRuleId":"WEBFMT-01"
},
{"id":"APPFMT-01","title":"Interactive product output exposes system state","section":"format-packs","normativeLevel":"MUST","scope":"app_interactive","requirement":"Interactive product MUST preserve task state, loading, success, empty, partial, stale, permission และ error meaning Navigation/actions direct, undoable เมื่อเหมาะ และ receipted เมื่อ consequential","acceptance":[{"checkId":"APPFMT-01-A","method":"interaction","criterion":"declared states understandable/operable ด้วย keyboard, touch และ assistive technology"},{"checkId":"APPFMT-01-B","method":"manual","criterion":"consequential action มี confirmation, progress, result, recovery และ receipt proportional to risk"}],"sourceTextSha256":"cc89d5ff8b3d8430d8666a0436545734394401b7f6434ce3ab552477be111bb1","sourceRuleId":"APPFMT-01"},
{"id":"DOCFMT-01","title":"Flowing documents preserve structure and working references","section":"format-packs","normativeLevel":"MUST","scope":"document_flow","requirement":"Flow document MUST ใช้ real heading hierarchy, readable pagination, working links, labelled figures/tables, source notes, accessible reading order, document properties และ version identity","acceptance":[{"checkId":"DOCFMT-01-A","method":"automated","criterion":"heading/list/table/figure/link/language/title/reading-order structure pass"},{"checkId":"DOCFMT-01-B","method":"visual","criterion":"no clipped content, accidental blanks, stranded headings หรือ unreadable notes"}],"sourceTextSha256":"caecb5fe6f8e7611e8cba6a43f9cd7b318a126a04e1388020fbb493dc6624fa2","sourceRuleId":"DOCFMT-01"},
{"id":"PDFFMT-01","title":"Fixed PDF preserves visual and semantic access","section":"format-packs","normativeLevel":"MUST","scope":"pdf_fixed","requirement":"PDF MUST preserve tagged reading order when required, bookmarks for long documents, selectable text where possible, embedded/approved fallback fonts, working links, alt text, page identity, evidence references และ print-safe contrast/margins","acceptance":[{"checkId":"PDFFMT-01-A","method":"automated","criterion":"metadata, pages, fonts, links, tags, bookmarks, extraction และ integrity pass as applicable"},{"checkId":"PDFFMT-01-B","method":"visual","criterion":"all pages inspected at screen/print size ไม่มี clipping, substitution, low contrast หรือ broken hierarchy"}],"sourceTextSha256":"30577cffd472cbcaa85f04eb5b5a89743094c06cbc2ff2097b09370ca7693b25","sourceRuleId":"PDFFMT-01"},
{"id":"DECKFMT-01","title":"Presentation decks express one idea per scene","section":"format-packs","normativeLevel":"MUST","scope":"deck_presentation","requirement":"Presentation MUST preserve one primary idea/reading path per slide, distance-legible sizing, section progress, source cues, speaker-independent key meaning, editable structure when required และ equivalent สำหรับ action/motion","acceptance":[{"checkId":"DECKFMT-01-A","method":"visual","criterion":"montage, distance legibility, overflow, contrast และ narrative continuity pass"},{"checkId":"DECKFMT-01-B","method":"automated","criterion":"titles, sources, links/QR, alt text, fonts และ hidden-slide state validate"}],"sourceTextSha256":"11ea0145ac338c549745d948754a7581822bb6c7057fc56807dca6cd819f9480","sourceRuleId":"DECKFMT-01"},
{
"id":"SOCIALFMT-01",
"title":"Social outputs are self-contained and destination-aware",
"section":"format-packs",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"social_static",
"requirement":"Static social ใน v0.9.7 MUST ใช้หนึ่งในสอง governed targets: `target.social.square.1080.01` ขนาด 1080 × 1080 สำหรับ feed post และ `target.social.og.1200x630.01` ขนาด 1200 × 630 สำหรับ link preview ที่ผูกกับ `publication.discovery.social` ของหน้า, communicate one approved message โดยไม่พึ่ง animation, preserve safe area, identify source/destination, use approved identity implementation และ legible at feed size Release นี้ยังไม่มี extension registry; social ratio/target อื่นนอกสองรายการนี้จึง unknown และ MUST block",
"acceptance":[{"checkId":"SOCIALFMT-01-A","method":"automated","criterion":"output resolve governed target หนึ่งรายการพอดี (square 1080 × 1080 1:1 หรือ og 1200 × 630 40:21); dimensions, format, size, color profile, safe-area และ metadata pass โดยไม่มี undeclared target/extension; OG creative มี recogniser ครบสามอย่างและ og:title ≤ 60 / og:description ≤ 155 ตาม template"},{"checkId":"SOCIALFMT-01-B","method":"visual","criterion":"square feed-size, center-crop และ safe-area fixtures (1080) และ text-safe 1000 × 560, central 630 square (LINE) และ 2:1 crop (X) fixtures (1200 × 630) preserve message, identity, evidence cue และ destination cue ≥ 22px; OCR + visual review ครอบคลุม OG image"}],
"sourceTextSha256":"2fdf4e9bcb5030f1bf39890ea3068ded191bfc17ffba615d2afa60e447e88d4b",
"sourceRuleId":"SOCIALFMT-01"
},
{
"id":"FORMAT-PARITY-01",
"title":"Meaning and action survive format translation",
"section":"format-packs",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"all",
"requirement":"Format translation MUST preserve content truth, hierarchy, evidence boundary, action outcome, locale status และ release identity พร้อมแทน unsupported interaction ด้วย governed static/structural equivalent; visual sameness ไม่ required",
"acceptance":[{"checkId":"FORMAT-PARITY-01-A","method":"automated","criterion":"equivalence map resolve identity, navigation, bookmark, CTA, motion, evidence และ receipt roles ที่ใช้ และทุก CTA destination binding ใช้ direct/static-equivalent presentation ตรง format"},{"checkId":"FORMAT-PARITY-01-B","method":"manual","criterion":"side-by-side review ไม่พบ claim scope, decision meaning, primary path หรือ action promise เปลี่ยน"},{"checkId":"FORMAT-PARITY-01-C","method":"automated","criterion":"triggered dataviz/map overlay resolves analytical, geographic, evidence, accessibility, fallback and export fields in host format"}],
"sourceTextSha256":"5752738f18411b65802412f493a2a1f64e6fdc1db892cb14a5b4bf944a1e8ebb",
"sourceRuleId":"FORMAT-PARITY-01"
},
{
"id":"COMPONENT-01",
"title":"Reusable components declare a complete semantic contract",
"section":"components",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"all",
"requirement":"Build Card `composition.componentIds` MUST inventory exact reusable component IDs ที่ implementation source ใช้ และ artifact-resolved implementation record `requirements.componentIds` MUST เท่ากับ inventory นี้พอดี ทุก ID ต้องมี machine-valid `componentContract` หนึ่งรายการพอดีสำหรับ selected `formatProfile`; cross-format parity ใช้ FORMAT-PARITY-01 และ format pack ไม่ใช่การใส่ `formatBehavior` หกรูปแบบลงใน resolved contract เดียว Visual similarity อย่างเดียวไม่เพียงพอให้ component ใช้แทนกัน ถ้า semantic intent, consequence หรือ evidence role ต่างกัน",
"acceptance":[{"checkId":"COMPONENT-01-A","method":"automated","criterion":"Build Card inventory, artifact-resolved implementation `componentIds` และ contract IDs เท่ากันพอดี ไม่มี duplicate/missing/extra; governing rules ของ contract เป็น subset ของ resolved rules; token refs resolve ไป exact governed token bytes และ fixture refs resolve ไป active acceptance/resolved-test set"},{"checkId":"COMPONENT-01-B","method":"manual","criterion":"rendered fixtures รักษา semantic intent, locale content, state, evidence/permission boundary, accessibility behavior และ static-format equivalent ตาม contract"}],
"sourceTextSha256":"a9ad6882a900b22e8bd295fcf53da11fd8fae5feaef44a4a91765fbb49c3d721",
"sourceRuleId":"COMPONENT-01"
},
{
"id":"MEDIA-01",
"title":"Media treatment follows semantic role",
"section":"components",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"all",
"requirement":"Crop, animation และ decorative treatment MUST gated ด้วย semantic role ของ asset Identity, evidence, maps, charts, UI captures และ provider content MUST fixed เว้นแต่ approved role อนุญาต transformation; alternative และ attribution MUST survive export",
"acceptance":[{"checkId":"MEDIA-01-A","method":"automated","criterion":"asset ทุกชิ้นมี governed role, source, rights, exact SHA-256, approval status, fallback และ text equivalent เมื่อ required; เฉพาะ `approvalStatus: approved` MUST มี `approvalReceiptRef` + `approvalReceiptSha256` ส่วน non-approved asset เป็น blocker และอยู่ได้เฉพาะ internal preview"},{"checkId":"MEDIA-01-B","method":"visual","criterion":"responsive/export crops รักษา evidence-bearing subject, identity geometry และ attribution"}],
"sourceTextSha256":"d429de3bbffbf49754df4fde6bb014cc032002552d2440764dc667be2bf114bf",
"sourceRuleId":"MEDIA-01"
},
{"id":"CAROUSEL-01","title":"Looping carousels keep one semantic cycle","section":"components","normativeLevel":"MUST","scope":"screen","requirement":"Loop carousel MUST มี semantic source cycle เดียว Visual clones MUST hidden from accessibility, inert, ไม่มี IDs/IDREF, non-focusable และไม่มี repeated meaningful alternative User controls MUST visible และ autoplay MUST off by default","acceptance":[{"checkId":"CAROUSEL-01-A","method":"automated","criterion":"clone audit ผ่าน aria-hidden/equivalent, inert, no duplicate IDs, no focus descendants และ no repeated alternatives"},{"checkId":"CAROUSEL-01-B","method":"interaction","criterion":"previous, next, focus, resize, touch, reduced-motion และ end-to-start preserve context"}],"sourceTextSha256":"169af7273e04c802fd13e8d2a42f1525455295d9ba66428daf2674d5d9eb3e6b","sourceRuleId":"CAROUSEL-01"},
{"id":"SOCIAL-FEED-01","title":"External feeds expose truthful states","section":"components","normativeLevel":"MUST","scope":"web_public,app_interactive","requirement":"External feed MUST declare idle, loading, loaded, empty, failed และ stale states ตาม applicable, รักษา provider boundary, โหลดหลัง primary content, มี direct fallback และใช้ recency wording เมื่อ freshness verified เท่านั้น","acceptance":[{"checkId":"SOCIAL-FEED-01-A","method":"interaction","criterion":"success, timeout, blocked provider, empty/stale response และ no-script มี truthful state/fallback"},{"checkId":"SOCIAL-FEED-01-B","method":"visual","criterion":"provider content ไม่ถูก invert/recolor จน meaning/identity เปลี่ยน"}],"sourceTextSha256":"93a786919266cf2bb3b72fca854303997163641235bb7ae8f1f89cfa990e1395","sourceRuleId":"SOCIAL-FEED-01"},
{"id":"QA-01","title":"Conformance is receipt-based","section":"quality","normativeLevel":"MUST","scope":"all","requirement":"Conformance MUST computed จาก applicable automated, manual, visual, interaction, accessibility และ production checks ที่มี dated receipts v0.9.7 ไม่รับ exception reference ใน artifact conformance: Build Card `qa.exceptionIds` และ Artifact Manifest `resolution.exceptionRefs` MUST เป็น `[]` ทั้งคู่","acceptance":[{"checkId":"QA-01-A","method":"automated","criterion":"applicable required check ทุกอันมี current passing receipt และไม่มี blocking failure"},{"checkId":"QA-01-B","method":"manual","criterion":"arrays ทั้งสองเป็นศูนย์และไม่มี MUST หรือ MUST NOT deviation ถูกนำเสนอว่า conforming; SHOULD recommendations are reported separately when useful"}],"sourceTextSha256":"e48cc91c082ebd7c6505cd3b1b7c88be1eddd366b90e7bbae135792428c5105d","sourceRuleId":"QA-01"},
{
"id":"RELEASE-01",
"title":"Release identifiers have one source",
"section":"release",
"normativeLevel":"MUST",
"scope":"all",
"requirement":"Release, schema, set, kit และ package identifiers MUST resolve จาก `machine.release` และ embedded contracts; published identities are immutable. Canonical schema `$id` MUST include the schema version and MUST NOT be reused for an incompatible contract. Generated artifacts MUST NOT contain conflicting current release identifiers. This document uses DS `0.9.7`, release `v0.9.7-owner.1`, color set `color-srgb-10` and document `standalone-0.9.7-r1`; document consolidation does not relabel historical signed subjects.",
"acceptance":[{"checkId":"RELEASE-01-A","method":"automated","criterion":"human master, embedded catalog/contracts, current tokens and artifact binding resolve the same release; unchanged schema `$id` identities remain exact and locally resolvable in the embedded schema collection"},{"checkId":"RELEASE-01-B","method":"manual","criterion":"provenance/change record identifies each consolidated rule, schema or value projection and its migration effect without claiming an unperformed approval or signature"}],
"sourceTextSha256":"00d2716c8573ae6e660a978ebdab60614fa86dc581fee3edea7731e8936e19b1",
"sourceRuleId":"RELEASE-01"
}
]
},

{"id":"measured","th":"ค่าที่มีข้อมูล","en":"Measured value","glyph":null,"map":"appropriate analytical class with label and unit","table":"exact finite nonzero number with unit","requires":["unit","source","date","boundary","limitation"]},
{"id":"measured_zero","th":"ศูนย์ (สำรวจแล้ว)","en":"Zero (measured)","glyph":"0","map":"lowest class fill + --dataviz-zero-outline 2px","table":"numeric 0 with unit","requires":["unit","survey completeness"]},
{"id":"no_data","th":"ไม่มีข้อมูล","en":"No data","glyph":"—","map":"--data-no-data-pattern 135° hatch + --border-emphasis","table":"— + short reason, sorted last","requires":["reason","latest available value"]},
{"id":"out_of_scope","th":"นอกขอบเขตข้อมูล","en":"Out of scope","glyph":"นอกขอบเขต","map":"bare basemap (no fill, no hatch)","table":"text label","requires":["scope statement"]},
{"id":"suppressed","th":"ปิดค่า (n<5)","en":"Suppressed (n<5)","glyph":"‹5","map":"--surface-soft + dashed --border-emphasis","table":"‹5 + rule","requires":["threshold","aggregation level that unlocks"]},
{"id":"not_yet","th":"ยังไม่ถึงรอบข้อมูล","en":"Not yet available","glyph":"…","map":"--semantic-pending-fill + dotted --semantic-pending-ink","table":"… + expected date","requires":["expected date","source cadence"]}
],
"treatments":{"measured_zero":{"map":{"fill":"scale lowest class","outline":"dataState.zero","outlineWidthPx":2},"table":"numeric 0 with unit"},"no_data":{"map":{"fill":"dataState.noData","pattern":"135deg hatch","stroke":"border.emphasis"},"table":"— plus short reason; sorted last"},"out_of_scope":{"map":{"fill":"none (bare basemap)"},"table":"text label"},"suppressed":{"map":{"fill":"surface.soft","stroke":"border.emphasis","strokeStyle":"dashed"},"table":"‹n plus threshold"},"not_yet":{"map":{"fill":"semantic.pending.surface","stroke":"semantic.pending.content","strokeStyle":"dotted"},"table":"… plus expected date"}},
"agentContract":"Every governed numeric value carries measured (finite nonzero), measured_zero (0), or an exceptional state (null)."

"contracts":{
"componentContracts":{
"schemaVersion":"1.2",
"releaseRef":"v0.9.7-owner.1",
"status":"active",
"shape":"format-implementation.schema.json#/$defs/componentContract",
"note":"Current standalone 0.9.7 component contracts. Stable component IDs preserve exact format/runtime behavior; six evidence states and exact color-srgb-10 classes replace superseded state and color clauses.",
"contracts":[
{
"formatProfile":"web_public",
"runtime":"browser",
"contract":{
"componentId":"component.evidence-card.01",
"componentClass":"evidence_card",
"governingRuleIds":["EVID-05","EVIDENCE-01","CLAIM-MACHINE-01","COLOR-01","A11Y-01"],
"purpose":"Present one governed value with its state, dataset, source, date, boundary, limitation, permanent URL and receipt id so that a third-party AI answer or a link preview carries provenance the reader can verify.",
"nonPurpose":"It is not a decision card, not a chart, not identity, and never a control; it makes no claim beyond the bound claim record.",
"semanticRoles":["figure","definition_list","link"],
"contentContract":"Props value, unit, state (one of six EVID-05 states: measured, measured_zero, no_data, out_of_scope, suppressed, not_yet), dataset, source, asOf, boundary, limitation, url, receipt; Thai and English label sets; the 3px four-colour rule and the 3 × 3px measure line are decorative and aria-hidden; the one-line text fallback repeats every field in order.",
"localeStressFixtureIds":["format.web.public.01.08","target.web.responsive.360-1600.01.fixture.thai-latin-stress"],
"states":{
"default":{"status":"required","behavior":"Value, unit, state glyph and label, dataset, source, as-of date, boundary, limitation, permanent link and receipt id are visible on one card without truncation at 320px width."},
"hover":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"Hover adds no information."},
"focus":{"status":"required","behavior":"The permanent link is the only focusable element and shows the governed focus ring."},
"activePressed":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"The card is not pressable."},
"selectedCurrent":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"The card carries no selection state."},
"disabled":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"An unavailable claim blocks emission instead of rendering a disabled card."},
"loading":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"The card renders only from a resolved claim record."},
"empty":{"status":"required","behavior":"A value in state no_data, out_of_scope, suppressed or not_yet renders its glyph, reason and latest available value or expected date; the card never renders an empty value slot."},
"error":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"A record that fails to resolve blocks the card."},
"success":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"Following the link is not a success state."}
},
"formatBehavior":{"formatProfile":"web_public","behavior":"Inline HTML with a one-line text fallback in the same DOM order; no logo, panel, gradient, motif or motion; the card survives copy-paste as plain text."},
"accessibility":{"name":"The card's accessible name is the value with unit and state in the reader's locale.","role":"figure with a definition list; the link is a native anchor.","value":"State is exposed as text, not colour or glyph alone.","order":"value → state → dataset → source → date → boundary → limitation → link → receipt.","status":"No live region; the card is static content."},
"tokenRefs":["tokens.v0.9.7.json#/dataState/valueStates","tokens.v0.9.7.json#/evidenceCard","tokens.v0.9.7.json#/foundation/text.metadata","tokens.v0.9.7.json#/foundation/border.hairline"],
"evidencePermissionBoundary":"Every field comes from the bound claim record and its evidence capture; the card never widens scope, certainty or permission.",
"acceptanceFixtureIds":["EVID-05-A","EVID-05-B","EVID-05-C","EVIDENCE-01-A","accessibility.web.contrast"],
"antiPatterns":["Logo or gradient on the card","N/A or bare dash","Value without state","Rounded estimate presented as measured","Link that is not permanent","Motion or motif on the card","Decorative bracket highlight or colored left-rail accent"]
}
},
{
"formatProfile":"web_public",
"runtime":"browser",
"contract":{
"componentId":"component.motif-frame.01",
"componentClass":"motif_frame",
"governingRuleIds":["MOTION-04","MOTIF-01","MOTIF-02","MOTIF-03","MOTIF-04","MOTIF-05","MOTIF-06","MOTION-01","MEDIA-01","A11Y-01"],
"purpose":"Mount one registered motif (dial, rings, layers, slice, cultivate or the logo assembly) from the exact motif.v3 runtime bytes with a declared job and beat, replay it while visible under OWNER-MOTION-01 through the page's MotionController, and hold the governed final-state SVG everywhere else.",
"nonPurpose":"It is not identity of record, not navigation, not a favicon, not evidence, never a control, and never a product overlay (overlays use their own registered runtime).",
"semanticRoles":["presentation"],
"contentContract":"Attributes data-kind (dial|rings|layers|slice|cultivate|logo), data-job (one of the kind's allowedJobs in motif-register.v0.9.7.json; any other value throws and preflight fails), data-beat (opening|transition|closing, matching the kind), data-variant (full|quiet; the light-theme variant), data-variant-dark (optional, quiet only: MOTIF-06 theme swap), data-host-surface (required: a carrier id from motif-register.v0.9.7.json#/carrierPolicy/carriers, themed ids checked per rendered theme, <id>@light|@dark for a fixed ground; the pair must be in carrierPolicy.allowed or the frame is refused and not rendered), data-cycle-ms (≥ 2000; logo 6000); wraps <lm-motif kind=… autoplay=\"false\" [quiet] [ink=\"blue\" for full]> with the kind's final-state SVG in <noscript> (both SVGs in .lds-motif-noscript wrappers, data-theme-variant=\"light|dark\", when data-variant-dark is set); the frame paints invariant and theme-fixed carriers itself and compares the rendered ground behind it with the declared carrier; the frame owns one IntersectionObserver (threshold 0.14, rootMargin 0px 0px -8% 0px), calls play() on enter and every cycle while visible, clears the timer on exit, and subscribes to the page-level MotionController.",
"localeStressFixtureIds":[],
"states":{
"default":{"status":"required","behavior":"The final state is visible before JavaScript runs and after every cycle."},
"hover":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"Hover does not start or stop the cycle."},
"focus":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"The element is aria-hidden and not focusable."},
"activePressed":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"Not pressable."},
"selectedCurrent":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"No selection state."},
"disabled":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"Pause is a page-level control, not a component state."},
"loading":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"If the runtime never loads the static SVG stays in place (fail-open)."},
"empty":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"No content."},
"error":{"status":"required","behavior":"A MOTIF-06 refusal (carrier not allowed, ink without a governed record, rendered ground ≠ declared carrier, invalid swap) removes the frame from rendering (ladder rung L5) and logs the code; a runtime or SVG hash mismatch, an unregistered job or a forbidden region blocks delivery."},
"success":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"Not applicable."}
},
"formatBehavior":{"formatProfile":"web_public","behavior":"Browser only; document, PDF and deck rendered in a browser may mount it; exported static files, email and social creatives use the final-state SVG of the same kind and variant."},
"accessibility":{"name":"None; aria-hidden decorative motion.","role":"presentation","value":"None.","order":"Not in the reading order.","status":"prefers-reduced-motion holds the final state; pause shows the complete final state."},
"tokenRefs":["tokens.v0.9.7.json#/motion/identity","tokens.v0.9.7.json#/motion/motifs","tokens.v0.9.7.json#/motion/motifs/carrierPolicy","tokens.v0.9.7.json#/motion/repetition","tokens.v0.9.7.json#/brand/blue","tokens.v0.9.7.json#/brand/beige","tokens.v0.9.7.json#/foundation"],
"evidencePermissionBoundary":"Motion carries no meaning; identity of record remains the approved PNG files; product overlays remain separate.",
"acceptanceFixtureIds":["MOTION-04-A","MOTION-04-B","MOTION-04-C","MOTIF-01-A","MOTIF-02-A","MOTIF-03-A","MOTIF-03-B","MOTIF-04-A","MOTIF-06-A","MOTIF-06-B","MOTION-01-B","accessibility.web.reduced-motion"],
"antiPatterns":["Editing runtime bytes","loop attribute without a viewport check","animation-iteration-count: infinite","Sampled wedge hex","Motif as favicon or OG image","Motif over the first answer, primary proof or primary action","A job outside the kind's allowedJobs","More than three moments on a route","Mixing a product overlay with a shared motif in one lockup","A full variant on Brand Blue, a dark surface or an atmosphere","A quiet variant on a light surface","A frame without data-host-surface","A declared carrier that differs from the painted ground","ink=\"beige\" or another ink without a governed file","Recolouring, plating or scrimming a motif to make it legible","Decorative bracket highlight or colored left-rail accent"]
}
},
{
"formatProfile":"web_public",
"runtime":"browser",
"contract":{
"componentId":"component.motion-controller.01",
"componentClass":"motion_controller",
"governingRuleIds":["MOTION-04","MOTIF-03","MOTION-01","A11Y-01","CTRL-01"],
"purpose":"Provide the single page-level pause/resume control that every MotifFrame (and any other OWNER-MOTION-01 replay) subscribes to; pause holds every motif at its complete final state, resume restarts cycles only for frames still at least 14% visible.",
"nonPurpose":"It is not a per-component toggle, not a preference store beyond the page, and never hides content.",
"semanticRoles":["button"],
"contentContract":"One <button class=\"lds-motion-pause\" type=\"button\" aria-pressed=\"false\"> per page with data-label-pause / data-label-resume in the page locale; exposes window.LandometerMotion { pause(), resume(), paused, subscribe(fn) }; MotifFrames register on connect and unregister on disconnect.",
"localeStressFixtureIds":["format.web.public.01.08"],
"states":{"default":{"status":"required","behavior":"Visible, reachable control with the pause label."},"hover":{"status":"required","behavior":"Governed hover treatment; no motion."},"focus":{"status":"required","behavior":"Governed focus ring; keyboard operable."},"activePressed":{"status":"required","behavior":"aria-pressed true while paused; label switches to resume."},"selectedCurrent":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"Not applicable."},"disabled":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"Never disabled; with no motion on the page the control is omitted, not disabled."},"loading":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"Not applicable."},"empty":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"Not applicable."},"error":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"Not applicable."},"success":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"Not applicable."}},
"formatBehavior":{"formatProfile":"web_public","behavior":"Browser only; static formats have no control because nothing moves."},
"accessibility":{"name":"Pause motion / Resume motion in the page locale.","role":"button with aria-pressed","value":"Pressed state reflects paused.","order":"Before the first MotifFrame in reading order or in the page utility bar.","status":"State change is announced through aria-pressed."},
"tokenRefs":["tokens.v0.9.7.json#/motion/repetition","tokens.v0.9.7.json#/control"],
"evidencePermissionBoundary":"None; the control carries no product meaning.",
"acceptanceFixtureIds":["MOTION-04-B","MOTIF-03-A","MOTIF-03-B","A11Y-01-A"],
"antiPatterns":["More than one controller per page","A controller that hides motifs instead of holding final state","Pause state persisted across pages without user intent","Decorative bracket highlight or colored left-rail accent"]
}
},
{
"formatProfile":"web_public",
"runtime":"browser",
"contract":{

"purpose":"Present governed rows with a caption, headers, numeric alignment, a mobile strategy, and a cellStates prop that renders each value's EVID-05 state.",
"nonPurpose":"It is not a chart and does not compute or normalise values.",
"semanticRoles":["table","caption"],
"contentContract":"Props caption, columns, rows, cellStates: one of measured, measured_zero, no_data, out_of_scope, suppressed, not_yet for every governed value. measured is a finite nonzero number; measured_zero is exactly 0; exceptional states carry null. noDataLabel remains a deprecated alias of no_data; show glyph plus reason in text.metadata, sort no_data last, show suppression threshold or expected date as applicable. Metadata/provenance requirements remain governed by the claim contract.",
"localeStressFixtureIds":["format.web.public.01.08"],
"states":{
"default":{"status":"required","behavior":"Caption, headers and aligned numeric cells with units."},
"hover":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"Hover adds no information."},
"focus":{"status":"required","behavior":"Sortable headers, when present, are native buttons with visible focus."},
"activePressed":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"Not applicable beyond native button behaviour."},
"selectedCurrent":{"status":"required","behavior":"Sorted column is announced and marked without colour alone."},
"disabled":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"Unavailable sort is omitted, not disabled."},
"loading":{"status":"required","behavior":"A loading table keeps its caption and headers and states that rows are loading."},
"empty":{"status":"required","behavior":"An empty result states what is unavailable, why, and the next action; it never renders 0 or N/A."},
"error":{"status":"required","behavior":"A failed load keeps the last good rows if any and states what failed."},
"success":{"status":"not_applicable","behavior":"Not applicable."}
},
"formatBehavior":{"formatProfile":"web_public","behavior":"Native table; on narrow viewports rows stack with header labels repeated; states keep glyph and reason in every layout."},
"accessibility":{"name":"Caption is the accessible name.","role":"table","value":"State cells expose the state label as text.","order":"Source order.","status":"Sort changes are announced politely."},
"tokenRefs":["tokens.v0.9.7.json#/dataState/valueStates","tokens.v0.9.7.json#/foundation/text.metadata","tokens.v0.9.7.json#/typography"],
"evidencePermissionBoundary":"Rows come from bound claim/evidence IDs; the table never widens scope.",
"acceptanceFixtureIds":["EVID-05-A","EVID-05-B","A11Y-01-A"],
"antiPatterns":["N/A","Bare dash","Missing rendered as 0","State by colour alone","text.muted for state labels","Decorative bracket highlight or colored left-rail accent"]
}
},
{

"accessibilityFixtureCriteria":{
"accessibility.web.keyboard":"Every interactive control, disclosure, navigation target, and CTA is operable in a logical keyboard sequence without a keyboard trap.",
"accessibility.web.screen-reader":"Initial HTML exposes the same headings, landmarks, names, states, relationships, claims, limitations, and actions to a screen reader as the visible page.",
"accessibility.web.zoom-200":"At 200 percent zoom, content and controls remain readable, operable, complete, and free from obstructive overlap.",
"accessibility.web.reflow-400":"At 400 percent reflow, primary meaning and actions remain available without two-dimensional scrolling except for intrinsically two-dimensional content.",
"accessibility.web.reduced-motion":"Reduced-motion and failed-observer states expose the stable final content and preserve every task and deep-link target.",
"accessibility.app.browser.keyboard":"In the browser runtime, every task control and state transition is keyboard operable with logical focus order and no keyboard trap.",
"accessibility.app.browser.screen-reader":"In the browser runtime, headings, landmarks, control names, permissions, progress, results, errors, and recovery are programmatically exposed and announced.",
"accessibility.app.browser.touch":"In the browser runtime, every direct touch control meets the governed target size and remains operable without precision gestures.",
"accessibility.app.browser.state-recovery":"In the browser runtime, interrupted, failed, denied, expired, revoked, and cancelled states preserve recoverable input and expose an understandable next step.",
"accessibility.app.browser.zoom-200":"At 200 percent browser zoom, task content and controls remain readable, operable, complete, and free from obstructive overlap.",
"accessibility.app.browser.reflow-400":"At 400 percent browser reflow, the complete task and recovery path remain available without two-dimensional scrolling except for intrinsically two-dimensional content.",
"accessibility.app.browser.reduced-motion":"In the browser runtime, reduced-motion and failed-observer states preserve task state, causality, progress, and the same reachable final result.",
"accessibility.app.native.keyboard":"In the declared native runtime, every keyboard-supported task control and state transition follows platform focus order without a trap.",
"accessibility.app.native.accessibility-api":"In the declared native runtime, task structure, control names, permissions, progress, results, errors, and recovery are exposed through the platform accessibility API and announced.",
"accessibility.app.native.touch":"In the declared native runtime, every direct touch control meets the governed platform target size and remains operable without precision gestures.",
"accessibility.app.native.state-recovery":"In the declared native runtime, interrupted, failed, denied, expired, revoked, cancelled, backgrounded, restored, and view-disposed states preserve recoverable input, semantic native-view order, platform accessibility traversal order, and an understandable next step.",
"accessibility.app.native.dynamic-type-200":"At the governed 200 percent platform text-scaling fixture, task content and controls remain readable, operable, complete, and free from clipping or obstruction.",
"accessibility.app.native.safe-area-interruption":"Across the governed native safe-area and interruption fixture, essential content, focus, progress, and recovery remain visible and operable.",
"accessibility.app.native.reduced-motion":"In the declared native runtime, reduced-motion and interrupted-transition states preserve task state, causality, progress, and the same reachable final result.",
"accessibility.document.native-structure":"The native document uses real title, heading, paragraph, list, table, caption, note, and link structures where those roles occur.",
"accessibility.document.reading-order":"Native reading order exactly preserves the intended section, figure, table, note, and action sequence.",
"accessibility.document.links":"Every document link and cross-reference has a descriptive label and resolves to its declared destination.",
"accessibility.document.thai-latin":"Thai and Latin text remains readable, selectable, correctly ordered, and free of missing or substituted glyphs.",
"accessibility.document.pdf-export":"The governed PDF export preserves document meaning, reading order, alternatives, links, evidence, and material limitations.",
"accessibility.pdf.tags-order":"PDF tags, heading hierarchy, and reading order preserve the intended content sequence without duplicate or orphaned meaningful content.",
"accessibility.pdf.alternatives":"Meaningful images, figures, tables, and data in the PDF have accurate alternatives or proximate equivalents.",
"accessibility.pdf.text-extraction":"Thai and Latin text extracts in the intended order without missing glyphs, unintended outlines, or semantic loss.",
"accessibility.pdf.links-bookmarks":"PDF links and bookmarks are descriptive, complete, ordered, and resolve to their declared destinations.",
"accessibility.pdf.print":"The PDF remains legible with sufficient text and non-text contrast in the declared screen and print conditions.",
"accessibility.deck.alt-reading-order":"Every slide preserves meaningful alternative text and a logical object reading order consistent with the spoken or visual sequence.",
"accessibility.deck.distance-legibility":"Primary ideas, labels, evidence cues, and actions remain legible at the declared room-distance fixture.",
"accessibility.deck.thai-latin":"Thai and Latin text remains readable and free of missing glyphs, overflow, or unintended substitution in editable and exported deck states.",
"accessibility.deck.links-qr":"Every link and QR action has a descriptive visible label and resolves to the same verified destination.",
"accessibility.deck.pdf-export":"Static PDF export preserves slide meaning, source cues, reading order, alternatives, links, and material limitations.",
"accessibility.social.contrast-legibility":"The social creative preserves readable message, identity, evidence cue, and destination cue at feed size with sufficient contrast.",
"accessibility.social.safe-area":"No essential message, identity, evidence cue, or destination cue enters the governed platform-safe exclusion area.",
"accessibility.social.thai-latin":"Thai and Latin text remains readable and free of missing glyphs, overflow, or unintended substitution in final channel bytes.",

},

"equivalenceMap":{
"identity":{"web_public":"role-approved identity asset in the header, or governed live-text identity when no approved logo role exists","app_interactive":"role-approved identity asset in the app header, or governed live-text identity when no approved logo role exists","document_flow":"role-approved identity asset, or governed text identity in native document text","pdf_fixed":"role-approved identity asset, or governed text identity preserved as tagged or extractable text","deck_presentation":"role-approved identity asset, or governed text identity on the title and closing slides","social_static":"role-approved channel-safe identity asset, or governed text identity; never reconstruct a logo"},
"navigation":{"web_public":"semantic site and page navigation","app_interactive":"semantic product and task navigation","document_flow":"ecosystem and property routes plus external destinations in a related-destination group separate from the page index","pdf_fixed":"ecosystem and property routes plus external destinations in a related-destination group separate from PDF bookmarks","deck_presentation":"ecosystem and property routes plus external destinations in an opening or closing related-destination group separate from section markers","social_static":"not applicable; preserve a single destination cue"},
"sideBookmark":{"web_public":"anchored page index that moves into the mobile disclosure","app_interactive":"task or section index only when stable useful sections exist","document_flow":"heading-derived page index represented only as the table of contents","pdf_fixed":"heading-derived page index represented only as PDF bookmarks and visible contents","deck_presentation":"heading-derived page index represented only as the agenda or section-progress markers","social_static":"omit"},
"primaryCTA":{"web_public":"typed destination binding rendered as a direct control","app_interactive":"typed destination binding rendered as a direct control with result recovery and receipt when consequential","document_flow":"typed destination binding rendered as a working link or explicit instruction","pdf_fixed":"typed destination binding rendered as a working link with visible destination or explicit instruction","deck_presentation":"typed destination binding rendered as a working link with visible destination, verified QR with text, or explicit instruction","social_static":"typed route, external, download, form, or contact destination rendered as one specific destination cue"},
"motion":{"web_public":"role-gated enhancement with visible source and reduced-motion final state","app_interactive":"state and causality feedback with reduced-motion final state","document_flow":"static final state and structural sequence","pdf_fixed":"static final state and structural sequence","deck_presentation":"static final state by default; presenter animation only when sequence meaning requires it","social_static":"static final state; no motif, overlay or animated identity on OG or feed creatives"},
"evidence":{"web_public":"visible disclosure linked to stable claim and source records","app_interactive":"in-context disclosure linked to stable claim and source records","document_flow":"source note footnote or endnote plus evidence appendix when needed","pdf_fixed":"source note footnote or endnote plus evidence appendix when needed","deck_presentation":"compact slide cue plus source appendix","social_static":"compact evidence cue plus durable destination"},
"receipt":{"web_public":"runtime success error and reference state","app_interactive":"runtime result recovery and durable receipt proportional to consequence","document_flow":"audience-relevant document version or source record; internal production receipt remains in the artifact manifest","pdf_fixed":"final-byte validation recorded in the internal artifact manifest; expose only audience-relevant version or source metadata","deck_presentation":"audience-relevant version or source slide; internal production receipt remains in the artifact manifest","social_static":"publication sidecar kept outside the audience creative"},

"method":{"contrast":"WCAG 2.x relative luminance ratio","compositing":"each visible authored paint (fill and stroke at the alpha the file authors; element opacity multiplied down the tree; opacity 0 elements excluded) over the carrier in sRGB, rounded to the 8-bit pixel a screen shows","gradient":"every stop; the verdict uses the worst stop","rounding":"two decimals, half up","shapeIntact":"every visible paint ≥ 1.30:1","tool":"measure-motif-carriers-0.9.4.mjs","reproducesApprovedEvidence":"ladder table 18/18 · evidence 88/88"},

"placement":{"full":{"carrierClasses":["light_plain"],"ink":"blue","inkNote":"runtime renditions keep the governed light-reference ink: <lm-motif ink=\"blue\">"},"quiet":{"carrierClasses":["deep_plain","deep_atmosphere"],"ink":"sky","inkNote":"runtime default quiet ink (energy.sky); no other ink value has a governed file"}},
"neverFull":["brand.blue","every atmosphere gradient","every dark surface","photographs","semantic state fills"],
"neverQuiet":["every light surface","atmosphere.ground.mist","atmosphere.measure.luminous","cultivate, diversity and product gradients","photographs"],
"themeRule":{
"declaration":"data-host-surface on every MotifFrame and on every static motif placement (data-motif-static=\"<kind>-<variant>\")",
"themedIds":"a themed carrier id (surface.*, surfaceAtmosphere.*) resolves per theme and is checked in every theme the output renders",
"fixedForm":"<id>@light or <id>@dark paints that theme's value in both themes",
"invariantIds":["brand.beige","brand.blue","atmosphere.ground.mist","atmosphere.measure.luminous","atmosphere.ground.current","atmosphere.measure.deep"],
"themesFrom":"<meta name=\"color-scheme\">: light, dark, or both when absent",
"swap":{"attribute":"data-variant-dark","admitted":"full in the light theme → quiet in the dark theme","runtime":"MotifFrame toggles the quiet attribute of <lm-motif>","noscript":"both final-state SVGs in .lds-motif-noscript wrappers (data-theme-variant light|dark) that resolve the theme like the page: data-theme on <html> first, then prefers-color-scheme; <picture>/<source media> follows only the OS preference and is not admitted"},
"groundCheck":"MotifFrame compares the rendered ground behind the frame with the declared carrier and refuses on a difference"
},
"inkRule":{"full":"ink=\"blue\" (the governed light-reference ink; without it the runtime paints Brand Beige under [data-theme=\"dark\"])","quiet":"no ink attribute or ink=\"sky\"","other":"ink=\"beige|mint|yellow\" has no governed final-state record and is refused"},
"refusal":{"codes":["MOTIF-06-CARRIER","MOTIF-06-INK","MOTIF-06-GROUND","MOTIF-06-SWAP"],"effect":"the frame is not rendered (ladder rung L5) and preflight fails"},

{"rung":"L1","name":"Re-test, do not re-tint","action":"Measure the asset's strongest authored element against the actual carrier hex, at the actual delivered size.
