{"rung":"L2","name":"Change the carrier, not the mark","action":"Move the mark onto another governed quiet carrier. Light ground too faint → the deep set. Deep ground too faint → the light set.","allowed":"any entry in quietCarriers, with its role respected","prohibited":"a plate, a scrim, a new tint, a gradient invented for the purpose"},
{
"rung":"L3",
"name":"Change the record, not the color",
"action":"Select a different governed record. This is selection, which is permitted; recolor is not.",
"routes":{
"ijji.four-beat.selected-3.r3":"six surface records exist per motif — canvas, brand-blue, ground-mist, dark, transparent-ink, transparent-mint. Light ground → transparent-ink (#182327, 11.4–15.6:1). Deep ground → transparent-mint (#0AD69C, 3.0–9.4:1). Ground you do not control → the boxed variant that names it.",
"landometer.motif.v3":"swap variant. quiet on a busy, photographic or atmosphere ground; full on a plain light ground. Never a full variant on a Brand Blue panel.",
"citychat-motif-set":"each of 3a / 3b / 3c ships a light and a dark rendition. Choose by the measured lightness of the real ground, not by the theme name: light on #F6F7F3, white, brand.beige or the dark-theme CityChat gradient; dark on #11191D, #172126 or the light-theme CityChat gradient #007A58 → #007E79. The renditions carry their own ground and grid lines, so they are never placed on a photograph or on another Landometer gradient. Status: candidate — owner sign-off pending on AMENDMENT.md.",
"identity":"swap rendition — see identityRenditions."
}
},
{"rung":"L4","name":"Change the presence, not the palette","action":"Raise the delivered size toward 1.5× the record's minimum, give the motif its own grid track instead of sharing the text column, or add two spacing steps of clear space.","note":"Size and separation buy perceptibility without touching a single hex. They do not buy meaning — a motif at any size is still framing."},
{"rung":"L5","name":"Remove it","action":"Delete the motif. Let text, a TrustBadge, a DecisionCard or a real component carry the meaning.","test":"Delete-the-motif test — if the truth on the page changes when the motif is removed, the motif was doing a job it is not allowed to do."}
],

"dispositionVocabulary":{"type":"array","minItems":6,"maxItems":6,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"enum":["retained","amended_in_place","superseded_by","deprecated_alias","moved_to_product_pack","removed_with_owner_reason"]}},

"newRuleIds":{"type":"array","uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9-]*-[0-9]{2}$"}},

"valueDeltas":{"type":"object","required":["source","baseline","rows"],"properties":{"source":{"type":"object","required":["name","sha256"]},"baseline":{"type":"string"},"shippedDifferences":{"type":"array"},"rows":{"type":"array","minItems":26,"maxItems":26,"items":{"type":"object","required":["token","theme","from","to","why"],"properties":{"token":{"type":"string","pattern":"^--(scale|series)-"},"theme":{"enum":["light","dark"]},"from":{"type":"string","pattern":"^#[0-9A-F]{6}$"},"to":{"type":"string","pattern":"^#[0-9A-F]{6}$"},"why":{"type":"string"}},"additionalProperties":true}}}},
"ruleIdReuse":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","required":["ruleId","lineage","consumerRule","disposition"],"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"ruleId":{"type":"string"},"lineage":{"type":"string"},"consumerRule":{"type":"string"},"disposition":{"type":"string"}}}},

},
"$comment":"Resolved standalone LDS 0.9.7 contract, revision standalone-0.9.7-r1. The distribution is owner-approved and unsigned; this schema is not a release attestation. Historical source identities and hashes are recorded separately."

"properties":{"artifactId":{"$ref":"#/$defs/stableId"},"artifactBuildId":{"$ref":"#/$defs/stableId"},"builtAt":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"},"formatProfile":{"const":"social_static"},"targetProfileRef":{"enum":["target.social.square.1080.01","target.social.og.1200x630.01"]},"buildCardRef":{"$ref":"#/$defs/safeRef"},"buildCardSha256":{"$ref":"#/$defs/sha256"},"creativePath":{"$ref":"#/$defs/safeRef"},"creativeSha256":{"$ref":"#/$defs/sha256"},"creativeMediaType":{"enum":["image/png","image/jpeg","image/webp"]},"creativeWidthPx":{"type":"integer","minimum":1},"creativeHeightPx":{"type":"integer","minimum":1}},

},
"locale":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"required":["primary","languageDirection"],"properties":{"primary":{"$ref":"#/$defs/locale"},"languageDirection":{"enum":["ltr","rtl"]}}},

"normalizationLog":[
{"area":"identity","change":"Current schema IDs use a unique standalone-0.9.7-r1 namespace; current release bindings and all mapped schema references resolve to 0.9.7. Historical source bytes remain untouched."},
{"area":"rules","change":"All 64 rule requirements and acceptance criteria are projected from the complete current human master; stable rule IDs, scopes, levels and required-core inventory are preserved."},
{"area":"evidence","change":"DataTable, MapLegend, EvidenceCard and capability schema enums include measured; value-state semantics resolve the embedded six-state evidence-value schema."},
{"area":"analytical","change":"Resolved overlays and format controls require the approved 41-sample light/dark LUTs and 3/5/7/9 classes; legacy dark derivation controls are retired."},
{"area":"social","change":"Build Card, implementation and sidecar accept square1080x1080 or OG1200x630; sidecar requires target-consistent exact creative dimensions and hash."},
{"area":"social-type","change":"Retains approved22px destination cue and visual legibility/crop requirements; unapproved fixed28px body/48px headline proposal is provenance only."},
{"area":"visual-preference","change":"Owner no-bracket/no-colored-left-rail preference and rendered Thai/English narrow/desktop review are explicit common controls; accessibility focus and meaningful data borders remain."},
{"area":"motifs","change":"Exact asset bytes and lifecycle contracts retained; active motif allowed-format lists follow the stricter social no-motif rule. Historical broad asset-format permission remains source provenance only."},
{"area":"approval","change":"Original asset attestation moves to historical provenance; current derived registry is unsigned. Separate scoped-check schema cannot claim full artifact conformance. Operational authority and artifact receipt signature controls remain intact."}
]
},

A source signature does not sign this document.","artifact":"Content truth, rendered usability, accessibility, actual surfaces, native Thai copy and output formats require applicable artifact checks.","installation":"File availability, retrieval and correct use must be verified in each project and platform."}
}
